splits: 20 development pictures of Shopfront and Wing; 36 regression pictures of six previously reviewed layouts.
selection_rule: Select on Shopfront and Wing: require more exact surface matches and higher pooled surface F1 than Wall Recovery, preserve all opening pixels, and rank by matches, then F1, then correctly assigned pixels. On reviewed regression require at least as many matches and no lower F1. Speed and number of models are excluded from selection.

mlsd.preprocessing: Pillow BOX resize to 512 square, float32 RGB plus 1.0 alpha

scalelsd.timing: Synchronized model forward only, once per unique image. Model loading, IO and one additional transform self-test excluded.
scalelsd.transform_check: Re-ran first frame with 512x512 output metadata and verified every native x/y coordinate independently.
